parsed.internal_thinking: The dice roll was a 9, which produced Wheat 9 for Gemma and Jimmy. My current resources are 1 Ore, 1 Wheat, and 2 Sheep. My Brick 6 (Hex 5) is still blocked by the robber, which is severely limiting my expansion. Gemma and Jimmy are in a tight alliance. I have enough resources to buy a Development Card (1 Ore, 1 Wheat, 1 Sheep), which is the best move right now. It gives me a chance to pull a Knight to move the robber off my Brick 6 and potentially steal from Jimmy or Gemma, or pull a VP card to get closer to the 5 VP goal. Trading is unlikely to succeed given their current pact. I'll buy the card and try to sow some seeds of doubt about Jimmy's growing Wheat hoard.
parsed.note_to_self: Bought a development card. Need to unblock Hex 5 (Brick 6) to start building roads again. Jimmy is accumulating a lot of Wheat (5) and just got more from the 9 roll.
parsed.say_outloud: ג'ימי, אתה ממשיך לצבור חיטה בכמויות בזמן שאתה מחלק פירורים לג'מה. ג'מה, כדאי שתבדקי טוב טוב מי באמת מרוויח מה'ברית' הזאת – הוא בונה פה אימפריה בזמן שאת רק עוזרת לו לחסום אותי. אני אקח קלף, נראה אם המזל שלי ישתנה קצת.
